title: Reload Rebirthed
description: we bring back the /reload command that was removed from 1.21.6+
body:
This plugin brings back the command **"/reload"** command this is great for testing plugins or just add plugins without restarting the server just do "/reload confirm" and its easy as that!

# **Commands**
![Reload Command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac3d52d6394158ca562dba3230451873c8a7ec88.png)


# **Features**
> ✅ Reload Configs
> 
> ✅ Reload Plugins
> 
> ✅ Quick Restarts
